chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd, from Muṣaddiq ibn Ṣadaqah, from ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Do not perform salat (prayer) in a house in which there is wine or an intoxicant.

key_terms.بَيْتٍ: a house or dwelling used as the place of prayer

ai.seo_question: Can one perform salat (prayer) in a house where wine or other intoxicants are present?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the place of salat (prayer), forbidding prayer in a house where wine or another intoxicant is present. It reflects the importance of maintaining an appropriate and pure setting for worship and distancing oneself from what is haram (forbidden).
